records.title: GASLITEing the Retrieval: Exploring Vulnerabilities in Dense Embedding-based Search
records.reason: The paper investigates adversarial vulnerabilities in dense embedding retrieval/search systems; the subject is retrieval security rather than model inference efficiency or compression.

records.title: Investigating Large Language Models for Code Vulnerability Detection: An Experimental Study
records.reason: The paper is an experimental study of LLM-assisted code vulnerability detection; it compares detection capability and does not propose an inference-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Exploring Quantization for Efficient Pre-Training of Transformer Language Models
records.reason: The paper studies quantization during efficient Transformer pretraining; its reported efficiency is a training cost/quality tradeoff, not post-training or inference deployment acceleration.

records.title: SparseProp: Efficient Sparse Backpropagation for Faster Training of Neural Networks
records.reason: SparseProp accelerates backpropagation by propagating gradients only through sparse activations; the contribution targets neural-network training throughput, not inference serving.

records.title: Learning Multiscale Transformer Models for Sequence Generation
records.reason: The multiscale Transformer paper changes sequence-generation architecture and evaluates generation performance; the reviewed results do not establish a specific LLM inference latency/memory improvement, so its link to efficient decoding is weak.
